Provider, loaded source, exact configuration, metadata, raw line/chunk and configuration cleanup descriptors are retained per record. Full return options are unavailable on these contexts. Captured global errorcode/errorinfo fields require the source/error-stack review in README; unavailable or incomplete fields are not promoted.

Retained evidence is sanitised: deployment fixtures use documentation address `192.0.2.10`; runtime logs retain NHO protocol rows without device envelopes; unrelated hardware/global virtual inventories are omitted. Historical execution-input and helper hashes retain their execution-time meaning. Forty connection lookup values replace peer-address tokens with `[redacted-peer-address]`; those result hex fields are explicitly projected bytes. Completion codes, actual events/units/invocations, ports, phase/cell sentinels and argv comparisons are preserved. No original transport bytes are retained. Artifact descriptors and seals await the coordinated refresh.
